rules: If something eats the cow then it eats the squirrel.
If something is kind and rough then it visits the cat.
If something is nice and it visits the cat then the cat needs the cow.
If something needs the cow then it eats the cow.
If something needs the rabbit then it eats the cow.
If the cow eats the rabbit then the rabbit needs the squirrel.
If the cow eats the squirrel then the squirrel is nice.
